notes.title: The Fruit Mountain Soundtrack Is Here! Get the Main Game + Soundtrack Bundle!
notes.content: [h2]Fruit Mountain ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK – Now Available[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3891090/_ORIGINAL_SOUNDTRACK/"][/dynamiclink]The long-awaited soundtrack featuring the in-game music from [i]Fruit Mountain[/i] is now available! It includes 7 tracks in total, featuring the main BGM with a full loop running over 7 minutes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57386/_/"][/dynamiclink]In addition, we’ve prepared a special bundle that includes both the main game and the soundtrack! This bundle is available at 15% off the regular price, making it a great deal![/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h2]Fruit Mountain Party Early Access Now Live![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/746e9b2f704249ff76434944864be4899d61d269.png"][/img]The brand-new competitive title [i]Fruit Mountain Party[/i], reborn from the original [i]Fruit Mountain[/i], has finally launched in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p][i]Fruit Mountain Party[/i] retains the core rule of merging the same type of fruit to make them bigger, while adding strategic use of various items and heated mind games. It’s a competitive party game you can enjoy solo or with up to four players.[/p][p]In the Early Access version, you’ll find a variety of game modes, dozens of new fruit types, a room feature that lets you battle with any player, and even support for Remote Play Together—so you can play with friends who don’t own the game![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🔻For more details, please see the Steam News post below🔻[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3467540/view/538863491448045674"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]🔻Purchase here🔻[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467540/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Fruit Mountain Party, the Latest Installment in the Series, Joins Next Fest!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/d21342abb84a9d17d161839332aa628e4e00caa9.png"][/img][/p][p]The brand-new [b]Fruit Mountain Party[/b], allowing up to 4 players to battle online, is coming to Next Fest, held from June 9, 2025 (PT)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/13316512e2e2bd5ba8e48105d0add1653984cd00.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/fc0a4668ef78f381919fb3d3f7c1f844685680fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A free demo is currently available, featuring "Random Match" where you can compete against rivals worldwide, and "Practice with CPU" to hone your skills solo![/p][p][/p][p]What's more, Art-chan now has a voice and talks a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to download the demo and enjoy the evolved online battles of "Fruit Mountain"![/p][p][/p][p][b]Fruit Mountain Party Demo available here:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3697250/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Add to your Wishlist here:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467540/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]We'd love for you to get behind the newest title in the series! [/h3]

notes.title: Art-chan Illust Work Introduction by FAN CONTEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/c74e9d9ee0f2fc979e2d5891391d62621d85ad31.png[/img]
Thank you very much to everyone who submitted their works for the "FRUIT MOUNTAIN FAN CONTEST". With gratitude and respect, we would like to present the award titles named by our official illustrator and comments on the works.
*Artist permission obtained.


[u][h2]＜Artwork Introduction＞[/h2][/u]
[h3]◆Artist: Erik Perez[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/46f9b37ec5e89e0ce74a5de38f6b042dc76b13fb.jpg[/img]
[b]<Award for the Cute, Soft Art-chan>[/b]
Thank you for the adorable depiction of Art-chan! The hat’s expression is a nice touch that contributes to such a cosy look. 


[h3]◆Artist: Subbibara[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/772a331a5f8739e56e62d6e40f664683539615ed.jpg[/img]
[b]<Award for "It's Okay If It's a Cat">[/b]
Art-chan's fruit mountain ruined by a cat! The expression of "Oh no, I almost reached the watermelon!" is so adorable. 


[h3]◆Artist: Miyaji[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/40d6abec0990bcb8f3e9aa605358ae745c4db1cc.jpg[/img]
[b]<Award for the Wonderful, Determined Gaze>[/b]
Thank you for the artwork featuring Art-chan with a composition and expression that truly embodies a painter! The squinting eye and the paint on the face conveys her strong sense of determination when honing her craft. The mountain in the foreground is also stacked with an impressively precarious balance. 


[h3]◆Artist: Watercolor Kirby[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/c23cf8340ea7d27e55337bd7e59ce662d3b9eb4f.jpg[/img]
[b]<Award for the Watermelon-Sized Smile>[/b]
Art-chan with a beaming smile! Are those stacked fruits in the background kiwano? She looks happy surrounded by her favourite fruits.


[h3]◆Artist : Juh[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/e4e44bdad992f027b71893ecdd1ce0d0f992bcf1.jpg[/img]
[b]<Give me back my fruit! Award>[/b]
A lot of fruit has been stolen!? Thank you for this illustration! It looks like a scene from a manga!



[h3]Thank you for submitting numerous artworks overflowing with love for Art-chan!
 We look forward to your continued support for "Fruit Mountain"![/h3]

notes.title: FRUIT MOUNTAIN FAN CONTEST
notes.content:
[h3]To celebrate the release of the console version of "Fruit Mountain," we are hosting a fan art contest for Art-chan!
Draw your best family-friendly rendition and win amazing prizes![/h3]

🍎 Post your art on X with the hashtag #FruitMountainArtChan 
✅Follow @BeXideEn
📅Ends June 27th

🎨Winners will be chosen by the development team!
🎨Lewd or R-18 fan art will be disqualified

[h3]🖋Art-chan Profile[/h3]
A young artist who loves to paint. She's indifferent to anything other than painting and often loses sight of her surroundings when focused. Always seeking inspiration. A great cat lover. Her favorite fruit is kiwano.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/bc2115de318d3737616c8bafd82d48e0f1adbc0a.png[/img]


[h3]We look forward to seeing your wonderful artwork![/h3]

notes.title: Time Limit Mode Added!
notes.content:
A new mode called "Time Limit" has been added in the ver1.1.0 update.

[b]■ Time Limit Mode[/b]

This exciting new mode challenges you to achieve a high score within a limited time of 3 minutes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/14b66880fde406a49eed932037b12dc7cec19b7b.png[/img]

In Time Limit Mode, the chain score bonus is higher than in the original mode, making it easier to see the difference in scores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/d40e6c3495ce1e9b3415a2596be31972848dd879.png[/img]

In addition, a dedicated ranking has been newly added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/d4d38af33f6b544cf946f89616c73ef535317e4d.png[/img]

Please try playing in both the original and Time Limit modes to aim for high scores!

We are considering adding new features in future updates. Thank you for your continued support of "Fruit Mountain"!

notes.title: "Fruit Mountain" is available from today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/9cd039984514d8b23425cad24fc963584f77e964.png[/img]
The long-awaited new game "Fruit Mountain" is available today on Steam in advance!
Stack the fruits on the plate so that they don't spill out!
Stack the fruits higher and higher to get the high score!


[h3]■What is "Fruit Mountain"?[/h3]
"Fruit Mountain" is a 3D physics puzzle game in which players stack fruit on a plate.


[h3]■The controls are super simple, but the gameplay is deep![/h3]
The player simply adjusts the angle and position and throws the fruit.
When fruits of the same type stick together, they change into larger fruits.
Carefully pile up the fruits so that they do not spill off the plate.
If a fruit falls off the plate, the game is over.
Play strategically while considering the size, shape, and stacking position of the fruits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/bf1552412992fb4eaf4fd4b3b87b828dcdb9d95f.jpg[/img]


[h3]■Go for the high score![/h3]
"Fruit Mountain" has a ranking function to compete for points.
Scores are increased according to the number of fruits changed!
Furthermore, you can aim for a high score with the Chain Bonus if the fruits stick together in a short period of time!
Sometimes, by playing boldly, unexpected chains may occur!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/2aca7ef2569328b0a5827bee18d394a69f4163f5.png[/img]


[h3]■A girl who paints in her studio・Art-chan[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/d822deab1ed422d7c6b0fd52f8f644d97a26463e.png[/img]
The girl who draws pictures and watches the fruits pile up is Art-chan, the main character of this work!
Let's create a "fruit mountain" so that Art-chan can draw a splendid picture!


Create your own "Fruit Mountain" and compete for scores with players from around the world!
